tactic.scheme: The pattern of T-tac-dual-has-chronal-neighbour, applied to two more two-sided nodes. P_of_dual : C.dual.P → C.P is a plain safe forward rule. P_dual : C.P → C.dual.P is a safe forward rule with pattern Causality.dual C. P is FutureOneConnected (Causal.Causality.dual_futureOneConnected, TimelikeHomotopy.lean:474) or LocallyStronglyCausal (Causal.Causality.dual_locallyStronglyCausal, DiamondConfinement.lean:400). Both are invariant under time reversal. For future_one_connected: ChronalHomotopyOn.dual reverses the curve parameter, and FutureOneConnectedOn.dual follows. For locally_strongly_causal: StronglyCausalOn W reads only CausallyConvexIn _ W, and dual_causallyConvexIn preserves it. Neither node is one-sided in DEC-163's sense.
tactic.termination: Unchanged. These are one-causality pairs: P_dual writes t.dual only for a t.dual already in sight, and P_of_dual writes a subterm that is already there. All 463 negatives of the new DualTest and all 814 of DualExact fail by exhaustive search (below).
